report:
Skin, left cheek, excision

Received in formalin is an ellipse of skin measuring 3.2 x 1.4 x 0.8 cm bearing an ulcerated nodule measuring 1.2 cm. A suture marks 12 o'clock, taken as superior. The lesion is 4 mm from the closest skin edge. The deep surface is inked. The ellipse is serially sliced and all embedded in 5 blocks.

(1) Tip A. (2-4) Lesion, cross-sections. (5) Tip B.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Excision
- Tumour site: Left cheek
- Tumour size: 12 mm (greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Squamous cell carcinoma, not otherwise specified
- Histologic grade: G1, well differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a well differentiated squamous cell carcinoma, invading the reticular dermis to a depth of 3 mm. It is composed of nests and sheets of keratinocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, keratin pearls and readily seen intercellular bridges.
- Depth of invasion: 3 mm
- Anatomic level: IV (carcinoma invades reticular dermis)
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified

Margins
- Invasive tumour: All margins negative
  - Closest peripheral margin: 4 mm (superior)
  - Deep margin: 3 mm

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT1 pNX

BWH tumour classification
- BWH class: T1: 0 high-risk factors

Additional findings
- None identified

SKIN, left cheek, excision
- SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA, well differentiated, 12 mm, invading the reticular
  dermis to a depth of 3 mm; completely excised (closest peripheral margin 4 mm,
  superior; deep margin 3 mm); see synoptic report
- pT1 pNX (AJCC 8th edition); BWH T1
